text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Is it... YOUR birthday--?! I'm gonna chomp 
ya! Chomp chomp chomp~~!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Huh...!? I'm the birthday girl and I'm the 
one getting bitten...!?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(As expected of Windy-san... She's a 
bundle of personality, so her ideas are 
just as wild!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(Getting bitten is a bit much, but... 
well, they do say the lion dance brings 
good luck, so maybe...)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(If I get bitten by the lion dance,\nmy 
self-production from here on out will be 
secure—\nor maybe not...)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(Heheheh... She's terrified, totally 
terrified! Everything's going smoothly so 
far!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(After scaring him with all this drumming, 
chocolates will pop out of the chomping 
lion dance mask, and Royce will be totally 
paralyzed with shock!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Now, put your hands out quietly!! 
Grrrrrrr...—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(Behold, the ultimate birthday prank!! 
Wahahaha, it's a huge succe—)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: —Then I shall gladly accept being bitten!
